cluster_summary: A set of vulnerabilities in inventory/GUI storage code that lead to item duplication due to inadequate synchronization between GUI and backing storage, missing player context in storage updates, and lack of validation of slot properties (fake slots, modification permissions). One outlier involves a missing permission check in a packet handler for file modification.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Pass the player who triggered the click to the setStorageItem method so it can validate per-player action uniqueness..

sub_patterns.root_cause: The method simulateCollectToCursor updates the storage element without passing the player identity, preventing the storage layer from enforcing single-use constraints and leading to duplication.
